caption: The drawing depicts a horse-drawn carriage with two brown horses in the foreground, both harnessed side by side and facing left. The horses have dark brown manes and tails, and they are outfitted with black and brown harnesses. The carriage has two large red-spoked wheels at the rear and one smaller red-spoked wheel at the front. The body of the carriage is mostly light yellow with gold accents and curved decorative elements. The seat of the carriage is upholstered in a patterned blue fabric, with cushioning on both the seat and the backrest, and there is a white or beige blanket or padding on the seat. Metal rods and a wooden double-handled bar form the handle of the carriage. The drawing is set against a plain cream background with no additional scenery or objects.
title: Doll Carriage
